name: action-conditional-v2
sealed_excluded_event: belgian-2024; preserve original 3.75% failed result; no parameter selection or rescoring
split: leave-one-whole-event-out for fitted pit priors; equal event weight for selection; no random cutoff/driver split
sampling: original saved development cutoffs only; no outcome retiming

candidate_budget.pace: latest clean same-stint completed lap, conservative previous-stint fallback; no trend
last up to 5 same-stint clean laps; median pairwise slope clipped +-1 second/lap, shrink n/(n+3), anchor latest two median; maximum extrapolation 3 seconds; at <3 samples latest-lap fallback

shared_policy.uncertain_weather: retain labeled fallback, no wet/dry assertion
shared_policy.SC_VSC_RED: explicit unresolved control causes abstention; no silence-based green
shared_policy.unknown_future_action: emit all predeclared branches; never choose from actual future

targets.stay: same fixed next not-yet-started lap as original; score both all-target proxy and action-matched diagnostic
targets.planned_pit: explicit hypothesis decided_at=cutoff, pit on next target lap; predict inlap and following outlap as separate components and two-lap sum; only score matched actions after freeze
targets.post_completed_pit: next full lap after prefix-confirmed pit exit, or explicitly unavailable if no defensible exit-time contract; do not relabel already-started lap

pit_prior: fit median residual in/out losses from training events only; validation event may use its completed prefix pit pairs; exclusions (red flag/control, insufficient preceding clean laps) explicit; no actual future pit duration input

selection.metric: equal-event mean all-fixed-target paired MAE ratio versus old prefix median; conditional branch errors separate and not a substitute for unconditional metric
eligibility: coverage no worse than v1 in any development event
no future timestamps or stale input predictions
equal-event paired MAE ratio <=1.0; no accuracy regression for advancing to new final data
selection.tie_break: lower macro MAE ratio; within 0.01 prefer guarded_last
selection.no_eligible: retain baseline and report inconclusive; no additional candidate search

coverage_and_wait: full/applicable denominator, scored/missing/active-control/abstention, conditional-action mismatch, longest sampled abstention run and seconds until first availability after prefix boundary; right censoring explicit
final_stage: only after bounded comparison select 3 unread 2024 events using cached calendar/session metadata, preregister exact identities and thresholds, freeze all source/prior hashes, acquire each once with ordinary bounded GET/cache; all forecasts persisted before scoring; no event substitution
ranking: paired sensitivity with same existing manual scenario assumptions and selected driver subset; source only prefix pace change; no factual causal strategy benefit
source_semantics: OpenF1 docs visited 2026-10-17: lap start approximate; pit date not explicitly defined as entry/exit; resolve or mark unknown. Documentation only, no new race observations read.
pit_prior_exclusion_detail: at least three prior clean laps with <=4s range; exclude known control interruptions; negative median residual floored at zero; no clipping of evaluation targets
